info.name: Doc Intelligence API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Doc Intelligence — OCR, Extraction & Document Intelligence Platform.

Endpoints are grouped by domain: Core OCR (Parse/Extract/Split), System, Providers, Uploads, Data Store, Jobs, Workflows, Banking, Observability.

Version: 2.0.0 | Contact: AI Platform Team

exec: body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email, password }) }

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Authentication endpoints (public — no Bearer token required).

Flow: Login → get access_token → use for all subsequent requests.
Token expires in 30 minutes. Use /auth/refresh to renew.

item.name: Core — Parse (OCR)
item.description:
Document parsing and OCR text extraction endpoints.

Supports: PDF, PNG, JPG, JPEG, DOCX
Modes: Synchronous (small files) | Background job (large PDFs)
Alias: POST /ocr is identical to POST /parse

formdata.description: Force OCR even for text-based PDFs
Process all pages or just first

exec: // If background job dispatched, verify job_id

item.name: Core — Extract
item.description:
Structured data extraction endpoints.

Modes:
- POST /extract: Upload file → OCR + Extract
- POST /extract-text: Extract from pre-extracted text
- POST /generate-schema: AI generates extraction schema from prompt

formdata.description: JSON array of fields to extract

formdata.value: Extract all invoice fields: number, date, vendor, line items, totals
formdata.description: Natural language description of what to extract

formdata.value:
INVOICE #INV-2026-0042
Date: 2026-06-01
Vendor: Công ty TNHH ABC
Total: 150,000,000 VND

Line Items:
1. Dịch vụ tư vấn AI - 100,000,000 VND
2. Bảo trì hệ thống - 50,000,000 VND
Extract all fields from a banking statement: transaction date, description, debit amount, credit amount, balance

exec: pm.test('Each field has name', () => body.schema.forEach(f => pm.expect(f).to.have.property('name')));
pm.test('Each field has type', () => body.schema.forEach(f => pm.expect(f).to.have.property('type')));

item.name: Core — Split
item.description:
Document splitting and categorization endpoints.

Modes:
- sections: Split into categorized text chunks
- document_type: Identify page ranges per document type

Use case: Multi-document PDF (e.g. loan application package with contract + ID + bank statement)

formdata.value: [{"name":"Hợp đồng","description":"Hợp đồng tín dụng, hợp đồng thế chấp","order":0},{"name":"CMND/CCCD","description":"Chứng minh nhân dân hoặc Căn cước công dân","order":1},{"name":"Sao kê","description":"Sao kê ngân hàng, bảng kê giao dịch","order":2},{"name":"Hóa đơn","description":"Hóa đơn VAT, hóa đơn dịch vụ","order":3}]

formdata.description: Allow chunks that don't match any category
Identify page ranges per document type

exec: pm.test('Error mentions invalid mode', () => pm.expect(body.detail || body.error).to.include('Invalid split_mode'));
pm.test('Has status field', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('status'); });
pm.test('Has providers array', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.providers).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Has provider id', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.id).to.equal(pm.variables.get('provider_id')); });
pm.test('Has success field', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('success'); });
pm.test('Has upload_id', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); if(j.upload_id) pm.environment.set('upload_id', j.upload_id); });
pm.test('Has uploads array', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.uploads).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Has entries array', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.entries).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Has total count', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('total'); });
pm.test('All entries have correct tag', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); j.entries.forEach(e => pm.expect(e.action_tag).to.equal('Parse')); });
pm.test('Has id', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('id'); if(j.id) pm.environment.set('data_store_entry_id', j.id); });
pm.test('Has correct tag', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.action_tag).to.equal('Parse'); });
pm.test('Tag is Classify', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.action_tag).to.equal('Classify'); });
pm.test('Tag is Extract', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.action_tag).to.equal('Extract'); });
pm.test('Tag is Split', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.action_tag).to.equal('Split'); });
pm.test('Tag is WF', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.action_tag).to.equal('WF'); });
pm.test('Has error detail', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.detail).to.include('Invalid action_tag'); });

item.name: Get Data Store Entry by ID

exec: pm.test('Has correct id', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.id).to.equal(pm.environment.get('data_store_entry_id')); });
pm.test('Has not found detail', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.detail).to.include('not found'); });
pm.test('Deleted flag true', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.deleted).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Has not found detail', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.detail).to.include('not found'); });
pm.test('Has jobs array', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.jobs).to.be.an('array'); });
if(pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test('Has success field', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; }); }
if(pm.response.code === 409) { pm.test('Has conflict detail', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.detail).to.include('Cannot delete'); }); }
pm.test('Has not found detail', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.detail).to.include('not found'); });
pm.test('Has workflows array', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.workflows).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Has workflow_id', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); if(j.workflow_id) pm.environment.set('workflow_id', j.workflow_id); });
pm.test('Has templates', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.templates).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Has endpoints', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.endpoints).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Has context', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('context'); });

item.name: Document Processing (Async)
item.description:
Async document processing API (feat-042).

Flow: Submit → Get job_id (202) → Stream SSE or Poll status → Get result.

Operations: ocr, classify, split, extract.
Supports file upload or upload_id reference.
